title: Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Assets…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 15.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Assets module. Authenticated users can access depreciation schedules of assets belonging to other companies without proper read permission checks. This exposure allows disclosure of sensitive financial details such as purchase value and depreciation entries.
